summary: Serialized project mutations with an exclusive temporary lock and made Angular add resolve its target from persisted or supplied UI metadata.

resolutions.description: init, add, and writing upgrade operations acquire a project-scoped exclusive lock; concurrent add regression verifies both snapshots survive and the lock is removed.
Angular add validation, file writes, barrel generation and metadata now use the resolved UI path from company-components.json or --ui-dir.

validation.command: node packages/angular/build.mjs && node --test packages/angular/test/cli.test.mjs && node scripts/check-angular-templates.mjs packages/angular/templates && node packages/angular/verify.mjs && git diff --check
